metadata.title: ARW Technical Note v4 Scientific Context
metadata.sourceTitle: A Description of the Advanced Research WRF Model Version 4
metadata.policy: Scientific context only. Do not enforce, auto-fix, hide variables, or block saves.
metadata.mainlineFeature: ARW Technical Note scientific context for namelist editor

temporal_discretization.label: Temporal Discretization
temporal_discretization.summary: Explains the RK time-split integration sequence, acoustic substeps, diabatic forcing, and hydrostatic option.

stability.label: Stability Constraints
stability.summary: Context for RK3 time-step constraints, acoustic time-step constraints, adaptive timestep behavior, and map-projection timestep considerations.

vertical_coordinate.label: Hybrid Vertical Coordinate
vertical_coordinate.summary: ARW v4 uses a terrain-following, mass-based hybrid sigma-pressure vertical coordinate that transitions toward pressure surfaces aloft.

map_projections.label: Map Projections and Map Factors
map_projections.summary: Context for Lambert, polar stereographic, Mercator, and latitude-longitude projections and their map-scale factors.

mixing_filters.label: Turbulent Mixing and Filters
mixing_filters.summary: Context for diffusion choices, eddy viscosity, sixth-order filtering, divergence damping, acoustic filters, and gravity-wave absorbing layers.

initialization.label: Initialization
initialization.summary: Context for idealized and real-data initialization, WPS data flow, vertical interpolation, lateral boundary data generation, and digital filtering initialization.

boundary_conditions.label: Lateral Boundary Conditions
boundary_conditions.summary: Context for periodic, open, symmetric, specified, polar, and nested boundary-condition behavior.

nesting.label: Nesting
nesting.summary: Context for horizontal nesting, parent-child staggering, one-way and two-way nesting, feedback, nested boundary conditions, and nest generation.

physics.label: Physics
physics.summary: Context for microphysics, cumulus, shallow cumulus, surface layer, land-surface models, PBL, radiation, and physics interactions.

stochastic.label: Stochastic Parameterization Suite
stochastic.summary: Context for SPPT, SKEBS, SPP, RPT, and stochastic perturbations to lateral boundary conditions.

nudging.label: Nudging
nudging.summary: Context for grid nudging, surface analysis nudging, flux-adjusting surface analysis nudging, observational nudging, and spectral nudging.

wrfda.label: Data Assimilation
wrfda.summary: Context for WRFDA algorithms, background-error covariances, 3DVAR, 4DVAR, hybrid EnVar, satellite radiance assimilation, radar data assimilation, and control variables.

time_control.summary: Run timing controls affect initialization windows, boundary data timing, output intervals, and restart behavior.

domains.summary: Domain controls connect grid spacing, timestep choices, map projection, vertical coordinate setup, and parent-child nesting.

dynamics.summary: Dynamics controls affect ARW numerics, diffusion, damping, advection, hydrostatic/nonhydrostatic behavior, and hybrid-coordinate behavior.

bdy_control.summary: Boundary controls describe regional specified boundaries, nest boundaries, relaxation zones, and global/idealized lateral-condition options.

physics.summary: Physics controls organize atmospheric process parameterizations, including microphysics, cumulus, surface, land-surface, PBL, radiation, and urban physics.

fdda.summary: FDDA controls grid, surface, spectral, and observation nudging behavior.

stoch.summary: Stochastic parameterization controls perturb tendencies, kinetic-energy backscatter, parameterization schemes, and boundary perturbations.

wrfvar*.summary: WRFDA groups control data-assimilation workflows, observation handling, background errors, minimization, control variables, radiance, radar, and hybrid-EnVar settings.

domains.time_step.summary: Primary RK timestep. This beta displays stability context but does not change the current user-editable suggestion policy.

domains.time_step_fract_num.summary: Fractional timestep component used with time_step_fract_den.

domains.time_step_fract_den.summary: Fractional timestep denominator used with time_step_fract_num.

domains.parent_time_step_ratio.summary: Controls child-domain timestep ratio relative to the parent domain.

domains.parent_grid_ratio.summary: Controls the parent-to-child horizontal grid-spacing ratio.

domains.i_parent_start.summary: Defines the nested domain start index in the parent grid in the west-east direction.

domains.j_parent_start.summary: Defines the nested domain start index in the parent grid in the south-north direction.

domains.feedback.summary: Controls whether child-domain information feeds back to the parent domain in two-way nesting.

domains.smooth_option.summary: Related to smoothing behavior around nested-domain feedback and topographic blending.

domains.p_top_requested.summary: Controls the requested model top pressure used with the ARW vertical coordinate.

domains.e_vert.summary: Controls the number of vertical levels used by the ARW vertical coordinate.

dynamics.hybrid_opt.summary: Connects directly to ARW v4 hybrid sigma-pressure vertical-coordinate behavior.

dynamics.use_theta_m.summary: Related to moist potential temperature treatment in the ARW governing equations.

dynamics.diff_opt.summary: Selects explicit diffusion formulation context, including coordinate-surface and physical-space diffusion.

dynamics.km_opt.summary: Controls eddy viscosity / mixing behavior in ARW turbulence and diffusion formulations.

dynamics.diff_6th_factor.summary: Scaling factor for sixth-order filter behavior.

dynamics.damp_opt.summary: Controls damping-layer formulation, including absorbing-layer and Rayleigh-damping context.

dynamics.zdamp.summary: Height/depth control associated with damping-layer behavior.

dynamics.dampcoef.summary: Damping coefficient associated with absorbing-layer or Rayleigh-damping behavior.

dynamics.non_hydrostatic.summary: ARW is a fully compressible nonhydrostatic solver with a run-time hydrostatic option.

dynamics.moist_adv_opt.summary: Advection option context for moisture scalars.

dynamics.scalar_adv_opt.summary: Advection option context for scalar fields.

bdy_control.spec_bdy_width.summary: Width of the specified boundary zone used for regional real-data lateral-boundary conditions.

bdy_control.relax_zone.summary: Relaxation zone control used together with specified boundaries.

bdy_control.specified.summary: Regional real-data parent domains commonly use specified lateral boundaries.

bdy_control.nested.summary: Nested child domains use nested lateral boundary data from their parent domains.

physics.mp_physics.summary: Microphysics family: cloud, precipitation, and hydrometeor processes.

physics.cu_physics.summary: Cumulus parameterization family: parameterized deep and shallow convection behavior.

physics.bl_pbl_physics.summary: Planetary boundary layer family: vertical turbulent mixing and boundary-layer evolution.

physics.ra_lw_physics.summary: Longwave radiation family: atmospheric longwave radiative-transfer parameterization.

physics.ra_sw_physics.summary: Shortwave radiation family: atmospheric shortwave radiative-transfer parameterization.

physics.radt.summary: Radiation call interval. The existing v1.0.0 suggestion remains user-editable and uses innermost grid spacing as a starting point.

physics.sf_sfclay_physics.summary: Surface-layer family: near-surface similarity and flux-exchange behavior.

physics.sf_surface_physics.summary: Land-surface model family: soil, vegetation, snow, sea ice, and surface-state behavior.

physics.sf_urban_physics.summary: Urban physics family: urban canopy and building-related parameterizations.

wrfvar*.summary: WRFDA scientific context from ARW technical note chapter 11.

obs_opt*.summary: Observation handling and data-assimilation option context.
